0x000810.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000881.en: 「Gah!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000909.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000983.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000A6A.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000ADE.en: 「Ngh, so this is where it ends!」

0x000B6E.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000BC2.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000C36.en: 「Gah! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000CAC.en: 「This is... as far as I go...!」

0x000D13.en: 「So this is the end... The rest is up to you.」

0x000D45.en: 「Damn it...!@ So this is where it ends!」

0x000D81.en: 「Ngh! So they got the better of me...」

0x000DBF.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000E0C.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E4A.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E91.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000F3C.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one to become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x000FF3.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give. Guess I miscalculated.」

0x001078.en: 「U... ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x00112C.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x001161.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!?」

0x0011A5.en: 「Any more and I'm done! I'm pulling back!」

0x00124D.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@ How green I still am...!」

0x00129B.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001314.en: 「Sorry about this!@ I'm getting out of here...!」

0x001385.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013F2.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x00147D.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0016A1.en: 「Gnngh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018B3.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x00196B.en: 「If they're calling in even me...@ has something happened involving the Ruina?」

0x0019D6.en: 「I don't know.@ They just said they had questions and told me to come.」

0x001A35.en: 「And it's the top brass of the military, no less.@ Why would they come straight to us...」

0x001A94.en: 「It's bound to be nothing good, either way.」

0x001AEA.en: 「Come, let's go. Bad manners to keep them waiting.」

0x001B2B.en: 「I summoned you because we've learned that Tochka 8,@ one of the Gaia Sabers' bases, may be developing@ a machine using Re-Tech technology.」

0x001C01.en: 「Y-you mean, like the Blanche Neige or@ the Aile Chevalier...!?」

0x001C78.en: 「Tell me, my dear young lady -@ does the term 'NV Unit' ring any bells?」

0x001D21.en: 「...I know of it.@ It's a weapon Professor Radcliff proposed, and I designed it.」

0x001D83.en: 「What? I've never heard a word of this...」

0x001DB7.en: 「Because the Professor swore me to silence.」

0x001E16.en: 「The NV Unit was designed, but the technical@ and financial hurdles made it hard to actually build.」

0x001E99.en: 「The Professor didn't want to argue with you@ over why he needed extra insurance...@ for something that might never even work.」

0x001F75.en: 「And so he handed the blueprints I completed@ to Alteur Steinbeck and@ Dr. Eric Wong.」

0x00202D.en: 「To get research funding from Alteur.@ Either way, there was no way we could've built@ something of that scale at Mother Base in Antarctica anyway.」

0x0020E7.en: 「So what exactly is it?@ This NV Unit...」

0x00213D.en: 「A super-large weapon-box hangar for@ the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige...@ a flying arsenal several times the size of the Ars Nova.」

0x002209.en: 「Docking with it boosts the Race Alcana's@ output conversion efficiency,@ firepower, and mobility.」

0x00229F.en: 「The one for the Aile Chevalier is called@ 'Geant Aile,' and the one for the Blanche Neige@ is called 'Excelsio Ars Nova.'」

0x0023C1.en: 「There were other development plans too, but@ they had all sorts of problems...」

0x002420.en: 「If the Gaia Sabers really are building NV Units,@ it'll only be the Geant Aile and@ the Excelsio Ars Nova.」

0x0024EC.en: 「Those can operate standalone...@ even without a Race Alcana.」

0x002563.en: 「So the Gaia Sabers can use them too...@ Why build them at Tochka 8@ instead of Grand Christmas?」

0x002611.en: 「Beats me... I don't know that much.」

0x002642.en: 「Lieutenant General Jacob, how reliable@ is this information?」

0x0026AD.en: 「It came from interrogating a Gaia Sabers contact...@ I'd like you to verify the truth with your own eyes.」

0x002736.en: 「So you're saying... go to Tochka 8@ and run a reconnaissance in force?」

0x00279B.en: 「Not only that.@ If NV Units really have been built,@ I want you to seize them.」

0x002829.en: 「For the Geant Aile and Excelsio Ars Nova to show@ their true worth, the Aile Chevalier and@ Blanche Neige are indispensable...」

0x0028FE.en: 「If we can obtain them,@ they'll be a huge help in the fight against the Ruina.」

0x002954.en: 「That's... assuming they were built@ exactly to the blueprints, right?」

0x0029BA.en: 「The NV Unit isn't the only reason@ we're asking this of you.」

0x002A2E.en: 「It's the Galilnagant I reported, isn't it?」

0x002A65.en: 「Correct. We want to know what the Gaia Sabers@ are hiding, even by force if we must.」

0x002AEB.en: 「There's a chance the NV Unit intel@ is a trap of theirs, but...@ will you take this job, Colonel Lefina?」

0x002BAF.en: 「You mean we strike at a Gaia Sabers base@ ourselves?」

0x002C0B.en: 「Yes. Tochka 8 may have a weapon-box hangar@ that can dock with the Aile Chevalier.」

0x002CC5.en: 「And if it does, what then? We swipe it?」

0x002D1E.en: 「Meaning, we go and nick the thing.」

0x002D8C.en: 「I just hope this Eric Wong built the weapon-box@ hangar exactly to Cliff's blueprints...」

0x002E90.en: 「Dr. Eric Wong is one of the Granzon's designers.@ So he's with the Gaia Sabers now...」

0x002F16.en: 「If he had ties to Shu, that alone@ makes him plenty shady.」

0x002F72.en: 「On that, I can't argue - not even I can.」

0x002FFC.en: 「He's a shady man, sure, but he was no villain.」

0x00303C.en: 「Yes... he helped me escape.@ And he harbors doubts about@ what the Gaia Sabers stand for.」

0x003124.en: 「But there's also a chance Dr. Eric Wong@ wasn't involved in developing@ the weapon-box hangar at all...」

0x0031F8.en: 「Well, we just have to go and see for ourselves, right?」

0x003244.en: 「Yeah, a surprise raid suits me fine.」

0x003272.en: 「By the way, the Blanche Neige's Ars Nova@ was a weapon-box hangar too, right?@ What's this new one like?」

0x00332C.en: 「Bigger than the Ars Nova...@ Cliff said it's a flying arsenal.」

0x0033A3.en: 「Ohh... that sounds impressive.@ If it beefs up our forces, I'm all for it.@ That Exe... Exet...」

0x0034C4.en: 「Hmm... is it really that hard to say?@ 'Exexbein.'」

0x003520.en: 「Yeah, that's the one.@ Real 'extra-large-serving Bein' vibe to it.」

0x003579.en: 「Oh no, there's more to pile on@ besides the Black Hole Engine.」

0x003600.en: 「Still a secret.@ You save your trump card for last.」

0x003653.en: 「You're just behind on the tuning, that's all.@ Finish it soon, or you won't make it in time.」

0x0036CA.en: 「True, but Minaki asked for help@ with the Jinrai's refit...」

0x003747.en: 「...If this weapon-box hangar really exists,@ we're going to be short on hands...」

0x0037D3.en: 「...Are you sure you're all right now?」

0x0037F8.en: 「Yes... sorry to have worried you.@ But as long as I'm a Machinery Child...」

0x003887.en: 「If I got my memories back... no, even if I didn't,@ I have no right to be here...」

0x0038F2.en: 「That's not true...@ What matters is now... not the past...」

0x003958.en: 「I was once everyone's enemy...@ but even so, Aya and Ryu and the others@ took me in...」

0x0039E8.en: 「Everyone accepted me as one of them...@ So you too, Ing...」

0x003A72.en: 「That's for you yourself to decide.@ The Mai of the past... did the same.」

0x003AD7.en: 「Ing... tell me how you honestly feel.」

0x003B17.en: 「Until now, I've lived to reclaim my lost past...@ to learn who I really am.」

0x003B9D.en: 「And to repay the kindness I was shown,@ I wanted to do what I could...@ But I didn't want to die knowing nothing...」

0x003C5A.en: 「Even a me like that had a place here...@ Even learning I'd been one of the Gaia Sabers...@ even after letting my psychic power run wild...」

0x003D30.en: 「Even if you're a Machinery Child,@ that doesn't change.」

0x003D92.en: 「Right... You fought Amara and Egretta@ and you're standing here now.」

0x003DFD.en: 「Thank you.@ Now that I know who I am, I feel like I finally@ understand what I should do next...」

0x003E93.en: 「Not just to learn the answer to@ what I was created for...」

0x003EFB.en: 「Together with all of you who accepted me,@ I want to fight the ones I should be fighting.」

0x003F88.en: 「But if I ever remember everything...@ and end up becoming your enemy...」

0x004002.en: 「Yeah... then I'll stop you.@ Not to take your life... but to save it.」

0x004073.en: 「Kurt... I'm leaving Itiiti Island to you.」

0x0040DE.en: 「All right, Touma... look after Irui for me.」

0x0041B0.en: 「Ing, for now I'm prohibiting joint use of the@　Black Hole Engine and the Tronium Engine.@　The latter stays your main drive.」

0x0042FF.en: （What is that...? He's looking at me...?）

0x00436C.en: 「Captain, surfacing complete. Launching the patrol craft.」

0x0043DD.en: 「It's a fast, agile machine, so it's suited@　for this kind of mission. He's got a navigator@　along, so he'll make it back fine.」

0x004506.en: 「Give it a rest.@　What's the harm in a little fun?」

0x004557.en: 「...Looks like they're having fun over there, meow.」

0x004591.en: 「We just launched, there won't be any enemies yet.@　Let him have his fun.」

0x0045F1.en: 「Masaki, contact on radar!@　Four o'clock, meow!」

0x004660.en: 「Judging by the radar blips,@　looks like a battle's underway...」

0x004721.en: 「Ngh, I can't believe this is happening!」

0x004780.en: 「I don't know, I've never seen them before either!」

0x0047D0.en: 「What are they planning to do@　with Presia once they catch her...!?」

0x004829.en: 「I-I'm sorry...@　It's my fault for not getting away in time...」

0x004891.en: 「Heh heh heh...@　I can feel your fear, your panic, your confusion.」

0x004906.en: 「Humans, fear us, the Ruina.@　And release your negative waves.」

0x004962.en: 「I-I'm not scared!@ I'm an Elemental pilot too, you know!」

0x0049CD.en: 「The dread hidden behind that bravado@　is the finest wine to us.」

0x004A54.en: 「I won't kill you here.@　I'll take you back to my king.」

0x004AD5.en: 「Because your waves differ from the others.@　Intriguing.」

0x004B4D.en: 「We're outnumbered...!@　How are we supposed to save Presia!?」

0x004BA0.en: 「I'll clear out the small fry with the Psycho Blaster!@　After that, I'll pin down the commander unit,@　so you save Presia!」

0x004C61.en: 「...Sorry, Zash.@　For dragging you into this.」

0x004CBA.en: 「N-no, it's fine.@　As long as I'm with you, Lune, I...@　And if I could, from here on too...」

0x004D3E.en: 「Presia, hold on! I'll save you, I promise!」

0x004D7E.en: （...She didn't hear that just now, did she?）

0x004DB8.en: 「Go on, struggle.@　And the faint hope you cling to now@　will turn to despair.」

0x004E48.en: 「I don't know who the heck you are,@　but I'll show you the power of the@　reborn Valsione!」

0x004EDB.en: 「There's an enemy that still hasn't moved.@　Are they planning to toy with us...!?」

0x004F52.en: 「Then that means we've got a chance@　to save Presia! Don't give up, Zash!」
